bwmfill_killsheep_22.m: My poor sheep! What have you done?!

bwmfill_killsheep_24.m: Just you wait - you will pay for it!!

tunlon_andor.m: I know Andor. Of course I do.

tunlon_andor_2.m: Always good for mischief, that boy.
r: Yes, that's him. Do you know where he is?

tunlon_andor_3.m: No. And I want to keep it that way.
r: Oh. What has he done to you?

tunlon_andor_4.m: He scared my sheep. They didn't dare to leave the stable for two weeks.

tunlon_andor_5.m: I then confronted him, even though I was a little scared myself.

tunlon_andor_6.m: And then? Nothing. With a look that made my blood run cold, he left.
r: Yes, my beloved brother. Who are you by the way?
Then that's settled. Another question: Do you have anything to trade?

tunlon_noquest.m: No problem, kid. Just come back here whenever you have some time.

tunlon_prog_1.m: Hello - are you back yet? I wasn't expecting you yet.

tunlon_prog_11.m: So how is your journey going?
r: Tinlyn said there is a woodcutter in Loneford who can help.
Tinlyn said there is a woodcutter in Loneford who can help.
I still have to ask Tinlyn.
I still have to look for the fences ...

tunlon_prog_16.m: Hmm, no, these posts are too short. My sheep are probably able to jump over them.

tunlon_prog_17.m: Could you go and ask him for other fences?
r: What? All the way over again just because you didn't tell me how high your fences had to be?
Do you actually know how far the path is?
I also have something else to do. After all, I'm on Andor's trail.

tunlon_prog_18.m: Thank you. I knew I could trust you.

tunlon_prog_1b.m: Have you found some wood already?
r: No, I asked Jakrar in Fallhaven, but he just sent me to other woodcutters.
No. I will go there next.
Yes. They created a shortcut here into the forest.
Yes. However, they only have firewood available.
Here, I hope these are better.
No, I am still looking for them.

tunlon_prog_22.m: Yeah, these posts are looking really good! Thank you, kid. Here, take this as a small reward.
r: I love running around and helping. See you!
Hmm, the lamb meat looks good. What is that exactly?

tunlon_prog_22a.m: This is lamb with a special seasoning mixture which of course I won't tell you. Here you have an additional one.

r: Yes. However, they only have firewood available.

tunlon_prog_2b.m: But firewood isn't good for fences.
r: Exactly. Where else can you get suitable wood?

tunlon_prog_2c.m: Maybe it would be better to buy the finished fences straight away.
r: Finished fences? Where do you get something like that from?

tunlon_prog_3.m: Hmm. Maybe my brother knows a place where to get fences.

tunlon_prog_4_1.m: Tinlyn, my brother. Poor guy, lost all of his sheep. He lives north of Crossroads guardhouse.

tunlon_prog_4_2.m: Tinlyn, my brother. He lives north of Crossroads guardhouse.
r: Ah, I think I know him.
I don't know this Tinlyn yet, but I will find him.

tunlon_prog_5.m: Please go and ask him, if he knows anyone who could help.

tunlon_quest_1.m: That is great to hear. Could you by any chance get me something from Crossglen? Unfortunately I have to stay here to watch my sheep.
r: Sorry, I have other things to do right now.

tunlon_quest_2.m: Thank you, kid. What I need is some wood to repair my fence.
r: Where do I get that from?

tunlon_quest_3.m: Oh, isn't there a lumberjack in Crossglen anymore? I haven't been down there for a long time
r: Maybe this explains why the forest around Crossglen is too dense to get through...
At least not that I know.

tunlon_quest_3a.m: What do you mean? The climb into the mountains is just northeast of Crossglen?
r: Maybe it used to be like that.
If there was a path, it has long since become overgrown.
I had to take a long detour past Stoutford and Prim and come from the other side.

tunlon_quest_3c.m: Then it's a good thing that I haven't tried to go down to Crossglen with my sheep in recent years.
r: In any case, there is no lumberjack in Crossglen.

tunlon_quest_4.m: Well, then you would have to travel over to Fallhaven. Of course only, if that's not too much for you.
r: Not for me! I know the way perfectly well.
Hmm, now that I think about it ...

tunlon_quest_4a.m: Please don't let me down. There are wolves and worse here threatening my sheep.
r: Sigh, I have too good a heart. It's okay, I'll do it.

tunlon_quest_4b.m: A pity. Come back if you change your mind.

tunlon_quest_5.m: Thank you so much! Here is a bit of gold so you can pay for it.
r: I will go and get it now.
Fine, thank you. Who are you?
Good. Do you have anything to trade?
Have you seen Andor, my brother? He looks a bit ...

tunlon_start_2.m: I am Tunlon of Crossglen. I look after my flock of sheep here.

tunlon_trade.m: Yes, I have a few basic supplies that I could offer. Do you want to have a look?

tinlyn.10: On the road to Feygard, near the Feygard bridge, I met a shepherd named Tinlyn. Tinlyn told me that four of his sheep have wandered away and that he won't dare leave the remaining sheep to go look for them.
tinlyn.15: I have agreed to help Tinlyn find his four lost sheep.
tinlyn.20: I have found one of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.21: I have found one of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.22: I have found one of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.23: I have found one of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.25: I have found all four of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.30: Tinlyn thanked me for finding his lost sheep.
tinlyn.31: Tinlyn thanked me for finding his lost sheep, but he had no reward to give me.
tinlyn.60: I have attacked at least one of Tinlyn's lost sheep and I am therefore unable to return them all to Tinlyn.

tunlon_fence.10: I found Tunlon, a sheep farmer, on the hill next to Crossglen. He asked me to help him get some wood for new fences. Since Crossglen doesn't have a lumberjack, I should go to Fallhaven and ask there.
tunlon_fence.12: Tunlon got furious when he saw that I killed his sheep.
tunlon_fence.20: I talked to Fallhaven's woodcutter. He told me that he had done a lot of work lately and therefore can't get any more wood for me. However, I should ask the woodcutters near Crossroads Guardhouse if they can help me.
tunlon_fence.30: The woodcutters told me that they have a lot of wood after clearing out the field around them, however all they have is firewood. Apparently this is not suitable for making fences. I should explain this to Tunlon.
tunlon_fence.32: Hadracor opened up a passage to the south, so I wouldn't have to take the long way up to Tunlon any more.
tunlon_fence.40: I talked to Tunlon again and he told me to talk to his brother Tinlyn if he knew any person who could help me out.
tunlon_fence.100: Tinlyn was glad to meet me. He said that Loneford had a woodcutter who could maybe help me out.
tunlon_fence.110: Tinlyn wasn't really happy to see me. However, he told me to go to Loneford.
tunlon_fence.150: In Loneford, I met a villager who told me he had some spare fences made. I should bring them to Tunlon.
tunlon_fence.200: Tunlon took a close look at the fences I brought him, but he didn't like them a lot. The fence posts were too short he said. I should go back and ask for taller ones.
tunlon_fence.210: The woodcutter in Loneford however said he couldn't make any fences, as he just cuts the wood. He recommended giving Brimhaven's woodcutter a visit, as he thinks that he can do some basic woodwork.
tunlon_fence.220: I gave the woodcutter in Brimhaven a visit and he told me to bring some wood, so the craftsman can make fences out of it. Loneford's woodcutter should have plenty, so I should go back and ask him for wood.
tunlon_fence.230: I got a pile of wood for the fences.
tunlon_fence.235: I gave the wood to the woodcraftsman in Brimhaven.
tunlon_fence.240: Brimhaven's wood craftsman sold me some nice looking fences.
tunlon_fence.250: Tunlon was happy to see the fences I brought him. These should be just fine, he said.

benbyr.10: I have met Benbyr outside the Crossroads guardhouse. He wants to get revenge on an old 'business partner' of his - Tinlyn. Benbyr wants me to kill all Tinlyn's sheep.
benbyr.20: I have agreed to help Benbyr find Tinlyn's sheep and kill all eight of them. I should go look for them in the fields northwest of the Crossroads guardhouse.
benbyr.21: I have started attacking the sheep. I should return to Benbyr once I have killed all eight of them.
benbyr.30: Benbyr was thrilled to hear that all of Tinlyn's sheep are dead.
benbyr.60: I declined to help Benbyr kill the sheep.
